{"CommandLine":"powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "
$jsxPath = 'C:\AI-BS\PrestigeMobileWash\src\components\PowerWashingDashboard.jsx'
$content = Get-Content $jsxPath -Raw

$content = $content -replace 'import ''./PowerWashingTab.css'';', ''
$content = $content -replace 'export default function PowerWashingTab', 'export default function PowerWashingDashboard'
$content = $content -replace 'PowerWashingTab', 'PowerWashingDashboard'

# Tailwind Replacements
$content = $content -replace 'pw-card-title', 'text-xl font-bold text-white mb-4 flex items-center gap-2'
$content = $content -replace 'pw-card', 'bg-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-lg border border-slate-700 flex flex-col'
$content = $content -replace 'pw-btn-micro', 'bg-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-600 text-white text-xs font-bold py-1 px-2 rounded'
$content = $content -replace 'pw-primary-btn', 'w-full bg-cyan-600 hover:bg-cyan-500 text-white font-bold py-3 px-4 rounded-xl transition-colors shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(8,145,178,0.4)]'
$content = $content -replace 'pw-secondary-btn', 'w-full bg-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-600 text-white font-bold py-3 px-4 rounded-xl transition-colors border border-slate-600'
$content = $content -replace 'pw-input', 'w-full bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 text-white rounded-lg px-4 py-2.5 focus:outline-none focus:border-cyan-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-cyan-500 transition-all'
$content = $content -replace 'pw-select', 'w-full bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 text-white rounded-lg px-4 py-2.5 focus:outline-none focus:border-cyan-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-cyan-500 transition-all appearance-none'
$content = $content -replace 'pw-form-group', 'flex flex-col gap-1.5 mb-4'
$content = $content -replace 'pw-form-row', 'flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-4 mb-4'
$content = $content -replace 'pw-table-container', 'overflow-x-auto rounded-xl border border-slate-700 bg-slate-800/50'
$content = $content -replace 'pw-table', 'w-full text-left border-collapse min-w-[800px]'
$content = $content -replace 'pw-discount-box', 'bg-cyan-950/30 border border-cyan-800/50 rounded-xl p-4 mt-6'
$content = $content -replace 'pw-divider', 'h-px w-full bg-slate-700 my-4'
$content = $content -replace 'pw-tier-badge', 'inline-block bg-slate-700 text-slate-300 text-xs font-bold px-2 py-1 rounded-md'
$content = $content -replace 'pw-status-tag', 'inline-block text-xs font-bold px-2 py-1 rounded-full'
$content = $content -replace 'pw-status-blue', 'bg-blue-500/20 text-blue-400 border border-blue-500/30'
$content = $content -replace 'pw-status-green', 'bg-green-500/20 text-green-400 border border-green-500/30'
$content = $content -replace 'pw-status-yellow', 'bg-yellow-500/20 text-yellow-400 border border-yellow-500/30'
$content = $content -replace 'pw-nav-ribbon', 'flex bg-slate-900 border-b border-slate-800 overflow-x-auto px-4 pt-1 gap-1'
$content = $content -replace 'pw-main-workspace', 'p-6 max-w-[1600px] mx-auto'
$content = $content -replace 'prestige-powerwash-container', 'flex flex-col min-h-screen bg-slate-900 text-slate-100 font-sans'
$content = $content -replace 'pw-header-deck', 'flex justify-between items-center px-6 py-4 bg-gradient-to-br from-slate-900 to-slate-800 border-b-2 border-cyan-600 gap-6 flex-wrap'
$content = $content -replace 'pw-brand-title', 'text-2xl font-black tracking-wide text-transparent bg-clip-text bg-gradient-to-r from-cyan-400 to-white'
$content = $content -replace 'pw-brand-subtitle', 'text-xs tracking-widest text-slate-400 font-bold uppercase'

Set-Content $jsxPath $content
